name: Russia–Ukraine
value: 4 killed, 69 injured in day to 15 Nov
summary: Russian strikes killed 4 and injured 69 in Ukraine in a day to 15 Nov; 41,000 Odesa households lost power
state: Russian attacks killed four people and injured 69 across Ukraine over the day to 15 Nov, and a strike on an energy site in Odesa region cut power to about 41,000 families, according to regional officials; the Air Force said Russia launched 132 drones overnight (Kyiv Independent). President Zelensky said Russia used more than 2,300 drones and 15 missiles in the past week; Ukraine said it struck refineries and an airfield inside Russia (RFE/RL). Talks have not produced a ceasefire, and mass strikes keep the Alert.
for_you: FCDO advises against all travel to Ukraine. Strikes on energy infrastructure tend to raise power-cut risk in Ukraine through winter.
rubric_hit: Mass drone and missile strikes on cities and energy = Alert
